Comment.value: Red Dragon Disciple initiation reagent (roadmap: red-dragon-disciple-quest). Drawn bare-handed from the Forge of Durin in the Lonely Mountain's main hall (q_rdd_forge OnUsed, instance tag DurinForge) only when the PC stands unwarded -- no Endure/Resist/Protection from Elements, Energy Buffer or Elemental Shield spell effect (QRDD_BloodIsWarded in q_rdd_inc). GetItemPossessedBy check at Halmir's turn-in (q_rdd_c_rdy). Plot + cursed so it cannot be sold, dropped or traded; q_rdd_finish clears the plot flag and consumes it.

value.0: An ember no larger than a walnut, drawn bare-handed from under the banked coals of the Forge of Durin. It is the fire the old wyrm breathed when he took the Mountain -- the fire that ruined Dale -- and it has not gone out in all the years since. It does not burn the hand that holds it; it beats instead, slow and patient, like a second heart that has recognized its own. Halmir the Grey asked that it be carried back to him.
